RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 50

An all-male panel at a public broadcaster may violate internal recruitment diversity policies, but alone it does not prove unlawful discrimination. It does, however, raise legitimate concerns about unconscious bias, especially given your five years as deputy news editor. Conversely, the emphasis on digital media could reflect a genuine strategic priority where the successful candidate scored higher.

Do not allege bias yet. First, chase up your written feedback to examine how candidates were evaluated against the job specification. Also check if organizational policy requires mixed-gender interview panels. If the explanation appears arbitrary, contradicts the job criteria, or is refused, consult your union or HR about raising a formal query.
